_comment: The response ladder mapped to Defender's device group automation levels (the Defender XDR implementation guide's Gate 9, design guidance): workstation groups at Full, Microsoft's recommended setting; server groups at a Semi level, because isolating a server is never autonomous in the program's ladder; a pilot group at Semi - require approval for all folders during its two weeks. The five level names are Learn's ('Exclude assets from automated responses in automatic attack disruption', read November 11, 2026). Contain User needs the sensor at version 10.8470 or later (Learn, 'Configure automatic attack disruption in Microsoft Defender XDR').
levels: Semi - require approval for core folders
Semi - require approval for non-temp folders
Semi - require approval for all folders
